import java.io.StringReader;

public final class LearnerProbe {
    private LearnerProbe() {}
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        try (Main.TokenReader in = new Main.TokenReader(new StringReader(" 5 3 2\n2 1\n"))) {
            Main.InputData input = Main.readInput(in);
            assert input.signalCount() == 5 && input.windowLength() == 3;
            assert input.brokenCount() == 2 && input.broken().length == 6;
            assert input.broken()[1] && input.broken()[2] && !input.broken()[3];
            try {
                Main.minimumRepairs(input);
                throw new AssertionError("Learner task must remain unfinished.");
            } catch (UnsupportedOperationException expected) {
                assert expected.getMessage().contains("minimumRepairs");
            }
        }
        System.out.println("Supplied helpers and unfinished tasks verified.");
    }
}
